correctness.rationale: Explicit Laplacian eigenprojection gives H_(i,j),(k,l)=delta_ik/b+delta_jl/a-1/(ab). Transfer-current two-edge determinants and exact counts of the three edge-pair geometries yield the variance formula. A derivative factorization makes all candidate extremizers reduce to a=2 or a=3; the cubic -(n-5)(n^2-12n+23) proves the exact switch. A standalone pure-Python checker passed 836 exact assertions including independent tree enumeration on every K_{a,b} with 1<=a,b<=4 and integer extremum tests to n=150. No infinite conclusion is based solely on enumeration.

value.rationale: Overlap measures consistency of independently sampled network skeletons. This is the first-two-moment analogue of 2023 expected-intersection work, with a complete natural fixed-size extremal classification: the variance maximizer has a three-vertex side at orders 6-9 but a two-vertex side from order 10 onward. The exact finite threshold and thin-versus-balanced variance growth provide structural information not given by asymptotic Poisson/binomial results alone.
